ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   C. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   D. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   C. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.
   B. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   D. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Effects of Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Evils of Gambling 02 5.4 Dua Dua on Increase in Knowledge  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Evils of Gambling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dua Dua on Increase in Knowledge 02 Page 12 of 64 xii 6 Muamalat 6.1 Etiquette o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
